therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: PPAR-alpha activation and lipid metabolism modulation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with schizophrenia, schizoaffective disorder, major depression, or bipolar disorder at elevated risk for coronary artery disease
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Plasma levels of triglycerides and lipoprotein cholesterol fractions at 4 months

results.effect_size: Triglycerides: 155 mg/dL (EPA) vs 182 mg/dL (placebo); LDL-1: 12.68 vs 16.92 mg/dL; LDL-2: 14.62 vs 15.79 mg/dL; LDL-3: 40.93 vs 43.47 mg/dL; LDL-4: 15.61 vs 17.66 mg/dL; HDL-2: 8.00 vs 8.56 mg/dL
results.target_engagement_evidence: Lower plasma triglycerides and LDL subfractions in EPA arm vs placebo at 4 months
